meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能将网页应用部署到Vercel并提供线上地址，同时可管理项目、域名、环境变量；部署前会验证身份、执行构建并检查线上地址。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署/发布网页应用，或管理Vercel项目、域名等资源时触发。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude会执行生产部署并给你线上链接。

say.text: 列出我的 Vercel 项目
给当前项目添加域名 example.com

howto.what_en: Claude can deploy web apps to Vercel, provide a live URL, and manage projects, domains, and env vars. Before sharing, it verifies auth, runs a build, and checks the URL is reachable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to deploy or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or similar resources.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs production deploy and returns the URL.

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to this project.
say_en.note: Adds the domain to the current project.
